nodes.title: Lyrics
widgets_values:
[Intro]
[Breathy]
Come closer, come closer
I won't hurt you... much

[Verse 1]
Pink and blue, I'm designed for you
Sugar-coated, gift-wrapped truth
One small taste, just one more bite
Melting slow through your night
I'm so sweet, I'm so soft
You could drown in me, get lost
Paint me pretty, paint me gold
But I'm nothing you can hold

[Pre-Chorus]
Can you feel it yet, can you see?
There's something hungry in me

[Chorus]
[Breathy]
Too much candy on my tongue
Too much sweetness, never done
Come and take a little sip
Bite the hand that feeds your lips
Too much candy, never stops
Once you start, you hit the top
Can't resist, don't even try
Watch me, watch me watch you die (sweetly)
I'm so sweet, I'm so sweet
But you're rotting at your feet

[Verse 2]
Rainbow wrapper, pretty lies
Gloss and glitter in your eyes
You can taste it, taste the trap
Once you fall, there's no way back
I'm the dream you can't refuse
I'm the poison that you choose
Every word out of my mouth
Pulls you deeper, further down
Smile for me, smile for me
You're becoming what I need

[Pre-Chorus]
Now you feel it, can you see?
You're already part of me

[Chorus]
[Breathy, Powerful]
Too much candy on my tongue
Too much sweetness, never done
Come and take a little sip
Bite the hand that feeds your lips
Too much candy, never stops
Once you start, you can't stop
Can't resist, don't even try
I'm the one who watches you
While you die (sweetly)
I'm so sweet, I'm so sweet
And you're rotting at your feet

[Verse 3]
[Breathy]
Now you're mine, you're mine, you're mine
Stuck inside my paradigm
All that sugar in your veins
Nothing left but sweet remains
I don't need your fight or fear
You're exactly what I'm here for
You were doomed the moment you
Heard the song inside of me
This is what you wanted, right?
This is heaven, this is night
You can't leave, you wouldn't dare
I'm the only thing that's there

[Bridge]
[Cold, Breathy]
I was never who you thought
I'm the sickness, I'm the rot
Every kiss a little death
Every breath you give is theft
I'm the sweetness, I'm the lie
I'm the reason that you die
And you let me, and you thanked me
And you begged me for more, more, more

[Build]

[Final Chorus]
[Powerful, Harmonies]
Too much candy on my tongue
Too much sweetness, never done
Come and take a little sip
Bite the hand that feeds your lips
Too much candy, never stops
I'm the one who wins, you lost
Can't resist, you never tried
I'm the siren, you're the prize
I'm so sweet, I'm so sweet
And you're kneeling at my feet

[Outro]
[Breathy, Fade Out]
Come closer, come closer
I won't hurt you... anymore
(Too much candy, too much candy)

[End]

nodes.title: Video Direction
widgets_values: The video features a young man in a bright yellow raincoat and round glasses, short curly hair, playing an acoustic guitar as he performs the song. He sits in a small wooden boat drifting through a field of floating paper lanterns for the entirety of the song, and the water is never seen, only the warm glow of the lanterns surrounding him as they slowly rise into the dark.
